name: chainmail
lore_template: Tens of thousands of {material_name} rings go to the making of one such coat, which reaches from neck to thigh, and each link is riveted through four of its neighbors. After an hour the weight settles upon the hips, and a swung blade is stopped cold against it.
forms_note: Rings stop a cut but part under a point: a spear or a bodkin arrow finds the gaps.
